ladder.title: Scene — the story ladder
ladder.hint: The fixed 7-level hierarchy (6 folders + a Scene). Highlighted = levels this project uses. Label a folder from the Scene sidebar → right-click → Label as.

world.title: World — the bible
world.hint: Each authored page in a tracked category becomes an entity the engine follows. Add or remove categories freely.

templates.intro: Reference layouts for different kinds of work — how each tends to organize its world and story. Nothing here changes your project; build yours under **Structure** with **Add category** / **Add level**.

examples.title: Examples — coming soon.
examples.body: Browse how other works organize their world and story, and start from one. (Will draw on the NVS datasets.)
